title: Outside rows write exposures and proposals and harvest promotes cross-repo candidates
body:
Why: Fable 1115a slice 3; the brain has one exposure line and one proposal.
Outcome: each outside row appends exposures and runs krn standards propose on Stop refusals; harvest over row checkouts promotes any candidate seen in >=2 repos into an enforced pack record.
Proof: krn standards effect shows >=6 rows; harvest output committed; krn standards check passes. Free.
